usedFor: Disqus holds site comments, and Google Drive copies a file when a “New Flagged Comment” arrives, through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Flagged Comment” in Disqus, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A flagged comment starts a copy of your chosen file in a folder you pick, under a new name.

watchOut: “New Flagged Comment” is polling, so a flag reaches Google Drive after a scheduled check, not at once.
